integrity.claim_basis: Self-contained analytic integral and limit proof with standard-library numerical cross-checks.

scientific_limitations: A single collision-only free-flight substep with uniform position in a Euclidean ball and isotropic independent initial velocity; forces and noise during the substep excluded.
Positive finite speed-third-moment assumption; arbitrary correlated or boundary-concentrated input laws and general domains not covered.
Divergent third moment concerns the exact substep reflection count, not total computing time of a complete Langevin algorithm.
Scientific priority over every unindexed specialized circular-billiard collision-count formula has not been independently verified.
title: Cubic grazing-collision workloads and an exact third-moment barrier in ball billiards
